title: 703. Knight Probability in Chessboard

examples.explanation: Two first jumps survive and the total survival chance is 1/16.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the probability as a finite decimal string; the checker allows 1e-9 absolute plus 1e-5 relative error.
Keep a table of survival likelihoods per square and roll it forward one jump at a time, spreading each square's mass over its valid knight neighbours divided by 8.
Only two layers are needed; the answer is the sum of the final layer.
